subject: Discovery recap & proposed SDK changes — Northbridge Health
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Gill <alex.gill@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap & proposed SDK changes — Northbridge Health

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have the same priorities captured: 

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Primary pain: long patient triage times and inconsistent triage answers across channels (forms / chat).
- Goal: reduce first-touch triage time by 40% and improve standardized answer rate for clinical-safety prompts.
- Data constraints: PHI-in-scope but must remain in VPC for production; audit logs required for each inference.

Proposed fit / integration notes (high level)
- SDK + streaming function-calls: recommend streaming responses for triage flows to improve perceived latency; use function-calls for structured triage outputs (JSON schema) that map to your triage engine.
- Embeddings + rerank: suggested hybrid approach — local embeddings for recent policy docs; Redwood rerank for clinical relevance scoring to avoid hallucinations.
- Quantization / performance: can run a 16-bit quantized variant on Dedicated capacity to balance cost and throughput.

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
1) I will share a mutual action plan (MAP) and our security summary — Sergio — today (attached).
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your engineering + security (Alex / Priya) — target this week — Alex to confirm availability.
3) Lauren & Ben will prepare a short SDK compatibility note + example function schema for your triage JSON — Lauren/Ben — 48 hrs.

Open questions we flagged on the call
- Which internal system will ingest the triage JSON? (format expectations / retry semantics)
- Latency SLO target for the triage path (95th percentile).
- Any additional compliance docs required beyond SOC2 / encryption-at-rest?

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_NB_v1.xlsx, redwood_security_summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 30m call to walk through the MAP.

— Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Gill <alex.gill@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed SDK changes — Northbridge Health

Thanks Sergio — good summary. A couple quick points and an intro: 

1) I'm looping in our engineering lead for integrations, Priya Desai (priya.desai@northbridgehealth.com). She'll own the deep-dive and will validate the JSON schema requirements.
2) On embeddings/rerank: we prefer patient-facing models to avoid CH risks; can you outline how Redwood’s rerank will be auditable and bounded (we need confidence on determinism / logs)?
3) Security: we do require encryption-at-rest + HSM for keys in prod. SOC2 is expected; I'll send our vendor security questionnaire to you after this thread.

Priya — can you propose 2 x 60m slots this week for a technical walkthrough? Prefer mornings EST.

On the MAP: looks good at first pass — thanks for sharing.

Best,
Alex
VP Product | Northbridge Health
alex.gill@northbridgehealth.com

- 10–25m: SDK integration walkthrough (streaming, function-calls, retries) + sample code paths
- 25–40m: embeddings & rerank design (local hybrid vs hosted rerank) + audit/logging options
- 40–55m: deployment patterns (Dedicated vs Private VPC) and KMS/HSM flow

Attachment notes: MAP (attached) contains milestones and expected decision dates. Redwood security summary provides the high-level controls; we'll work with you on the vendor questionnaire next.

- Example of the triage JSON schema you expect (or the target system endpoint) — Priya
- 95th percentile latency target for triage path (this will drive batching/config) — Alex

Sergio action items (post-meeting)
- Send MAP + security summary (attached) — done
- Share an SDK sample (streaming + function-calls) before deep-dive — Ben to draft (cc'd)

Proposed times (Priya): Wed 11/4 10:00–11:00 EST or Thu 11/5 09:00–10:00 EST. Priya — please confirm which works.

Best,
Sergio

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & proposed SDK changes — Northbridge Health

Looping back with the SDK compatibility note we discussed. Quick bullets for the deep-dive so engineering has something concrete: 

- SDK: current JS & Python clients support streaming responses with incremental JSON assembly; we'll show a small example that emits partial answers and a final function-call payload.
- Function-calls: recommend a single top-level "triage_result" schema with fields {"category", "urgency_score", "structured_followup"}; we'll include sample schema in the call.
- Retries & idempotency: SDK will surface a request_id for each session; recommend your ingestion endpoint accept idempotency_key to avoid duplicate triage events.
- Embeddings/rerank: we'll demo a local embedding index for policy docs + Redwood-hosted rerank model; logs include top-k scores and model_version to aid audits.

Ben and I will join the deep-dive; Ben will bring the sample SDK snippet (Python streaming + function-call). Sergio — if you confirm Thu 11/5 09:00 EST for the deep-dive, we’ll finalize the demo kit.

— Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
